dt: Priority consideration was Sep 11, 2026; applications accepted until the posting is removed
e: A 2-year postdoc developing spatially resolved resonant soft x-ray and magnetic reflectometry at ALS beamlines 4.0.2 and 7.0.1.1, including focusing optics and ML-assisted analysis of thin-film magnetic and ferroelectric materials. Requires a PhD in physics, chemistry, materials science or similar and fewer than 3 years of paid postdoc experience. Applicants must be eligible to work in the US at hire; no visa sponsorship.
f: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (Advanced Light Source)
n: Berkeley Lab ALS: Spatially Resolved Soft X-ray Reflectometry Postdoctoral Fellow
